products.product_description: Original Silk Light Soymilk Half Gallon, Distributed by WhiteWave Foods Broomfield, Colorado 80021, UPC 0 25293 60101 7
products.code_info: Use by dates of 06/22/14 and 06/23/14 will be found on the carton's gable top. 06/22 or 23/14 hh:mm 48-0994 EH3-5 1; 06/22 or 23/14 hh:mm 48-0994 EH3-5 2; 06/22 or 23/14 hh:mm 48-0994 EH3-4 3; and 06/22 or 23/14 hh:mm 48-0994 EH3-4 4. Code breakdown as follows: 6/22/14 and 6/23/14 are the expiration dates; hh:mm is the manufacturing time stamp and varies across the run; 48-0994 is the manufacturing plant code; EH3 is the filler model generation; and the Remaining numbers are filling machine and lane designations
products.reason_for_recall: The product has the potential to contain undeclared almondmilk.
